ValidationRule.description: Ensure cart quantity is at least 1 and prices are not negative
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Quantity__c), Quantity__c < 1, ISBLANK(Unit_Price__c), Unit_Price__c < 0, AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Line_Total__c)), Line_Total__c < 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cart quantity must be at least 1, and item prices and totals cannot be negative.
